display_name: PAMF 三分支结构消融：第一阶段
description: 去除参考响应，比较时域、频域、功放和三视图路径描述。12结构×3种子；9模型同契约复用、27模型新增训练。仅分类损失监督，raw识别，跨接收机与跨日跨接收机独立评分。
authorization: 用户明确授权第一阶段分支消融、复用同契约产物、充分使用空闲显卡，训练后自动测试。

code.commit: release Git HEAD, recorded independently in runtime.json
code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI; FP32 TF32off; Python and torch from preregistered environment; 2 CPU threads

data.physical_ids_ref: Existing F0 role_ids and physical_ID_index_v1; unchanged cached source/test handles
data.validation_ref: Reuse VALIDATED_ONCE; no data membership/bytes change
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 raw inference only; cross-RX 126000, cross-day-cross-RX 42000, pooled168000; seven views
data.leo_config_ref: Existing clean plus six practical views; no additional LEO

permissions.regime: PAMF pure CE L_s only; no U/EMA/PL or restoration; retain source channel CE 0.68
permissions.query_use: Freeze both preregistered populations x seven views before independent CPU truth-last
permissions.claim_scope: Exposed Phase1 benchmark; no target feedback or independent-blind selection claim

checkpoint.initialization: 27 new scratch20+own10+own20; 9 exact structural CE models reused read-only
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Read-only same full source contract, model seed, epochs, budget, objective, graph and complete frozen outputs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: 9 same-contract source checkpoints and predictions/scores checked; new models from scratch

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU0-7; at most2 total GPU compute processes/card including other owners and pending; free>=12000 MiB; CPU<75%, RAM available>=64GiB, IOwait<5%; CPU scorer<=1
execution.stop_rule: Source-only actual-checkpoint and branch finite-backward smoke first; two same systemic technical fingerprints stop new dispatch; retain healthy tasks and artifacts; no result-dependent selection

expected_artifacts: 9 reused source predictions and independent scores
36 model paired seed and pooled population report

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent CPU score after both populations and all seven views frozen
